description: An assistant that reads a table state through vision, then helps analyse a hand with a clear explanation.

sections.title: The concept
sections.content:
The goal wasn’t to output a "magic move", but to make a decision readable: what vision understood, what gets evaluated, and why.

  • Vision → table state (cards, positions, context).
  • Evaluation → calculations and rules.
  • Output → clear, decision-oriented explanation.

sections.title: What I built
sections.content:
• YOLO to detect cards/state, with cleanup and consistency checks.
  • Python for evaluation (odds, rules) and explanation assembly.
  • End-to-end chain (vision → compute → text) designed to be testable and iterable.
